whatIs.paragraph1: You may have a great product, flawless service, and a stylish website. But if you are not on the first page when your potential customers search on Google, you are virtually invisible in the digital world.
whatIs.paragraph2: Paid ads (PPC) stop the moment you cut the budget. SEO, on the contrary, is the most profitable long-term investment that provides compounding returns over time, increases the value of your digital presence, and drops your cost-per-click to zero.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about SEO processes and expectations.

delivery.question: When do SEO efforts start showing results?
delivery.answer: The results of initial technical improvements are reflected in indexing within the first 1-2 months. However, seeing a meaningful, lasting growth in keyword rankings and organic traffic generally takes 3 to 6 months depending on the industry's competition.

pricing.question: How are monthly SEO consultancy fees determined?
pricing.answer: We prepare a custom, transparent 'retainer' (monthly contract) quote based on the current state of your site (number of pages, technical health), the competitive difficulty of your target market, and the volume of content to be produced monthly.

revisions.question: Why do you require a minimum 6-month contract?
revisions.answer: SEO is a long-term investment that needs solid foundations. 6 months is the minimum healthy period required for algorithms to make sense of the changes made and for your site to gain authority.

maintenance.question: Do you do the technical SEO coding and on-site fixes?
maintenance.answer: Yes, we directly implement basic technical updates that require software expertise. If you have your own in-house dev team, we coordinate the process by providing them with clear, actionable briefs.

migration.question: We are going to redesign my site; will I lose my existing SEO value (traffic)?
migration.answer: If not planned correctly, yes. But with our 'SEO Migration' strategy, we flawlessly set up URL redirects (301s) and architecture, safely transferring years of accumulated SEO value to the new site.

mobile.question: Is there a need for SEO when there are paid ads (Google Ads)?
mobile.answer: Absolutely. The moment the ad budget stops, traffic drops to zero. SEO, on the other hand, is your site's permanent digital real estate value. They complement each other; as SEO strengthens, your dependence on ads and your costs decrease.
